spec.policy: independent randomized pilot fits immediate action contrast; probability .2 or .7 by fitted contrast above .5; held fixed for every evaluation repetition
spec.inference: two-sided nominal 95% normal interval for within-trajectory contrast, conditional on pilot policy; all requested repetitions counted
spec.nuisances: logistic regression for action/survival; arm-specific histogram boosting continuation regressions; whole-trajectory 2-fold fitting
spec.scope: continuous sufficient observed-history summaries with action memory; monotone dropout. MNAR deliberately violates the score's identifying assumptions. No claim of optimal learned policy or generic ML rates.
